# 代码会自动保存到data.txt文件中

print("Hello, World!")

def example_function():
    """这是一个示例函数"""
    for i in range(5):
        print(f"计数: {i}")
        
class ExampleClass:
    """示例类"""
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
    
    def greet(self):
        return f"Hello, {self.name}!"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    example_function()
    obj = ExampleClass("Python")
    print(obj.greet())
